items.titleZh: 哈斯车队签下卡马拉加入2027赛季F1
items.summaryZh: 哈斯车队签下法拉利青训车手拉斐尔·卡马拉，取代从2027赛季开始效力于该队的埃斯特班·奥康。这是否是一个明智的决定？卡马拉能为车队带来什么，这对他的2027赛季队友奥利·贝尔曼意味着什么？
items.originalTitle: Our verdict on Haas signing Camara for F1 2027
detailZh: 哈斯车队已签约法拉利青训车手拉斐尔·卡马拉，将从2027赛季开始取代埃斯特班·奥康。
这是一个明智的决定吗？我们可以期待卡马拉带来什么，这对他的2027赛季队友奥利·贝尔曼意味着什么？
F1 2027赛季车队的绝佳补充
如果拉斐尔·卡马拉的表现像我听说他在哈斯F1测试首秀时那样令人兴奋，那么他就是F1车队的绝佳补充。
他的青训车队生涯的资历使他无论如何都是一个值得尊敬的毕业生。这位车手曾是卡丁车领域的佼佼者，现在他已经连续在单座赛车领域取得了越来越高的成绩。
赢得冠军从来都不容易，但这本身并不能保证拥有在F1中茁壮成长的能力或特质。在F1赛车上的工作，即使在短暂的机会中，也往往比其他因素更重要。
哈斯车队显然已经从其青训车队的简历中意识到卡马拉是一个有潜力的新星。但是，据我所知，当卡马拉在波尔蒂马奥驾驶车队赛车时，他彻底征服了车队。他的速度如此之快，以至于哈斯车队中的一些人认为，即使奥利·贝尔曼——他在那天短暂驾驶以建立参考标准——即使有完整的比赛计划也不会这么快。
这并不是说卡马拉比贝尔曼更快或者更有潜力。但他就是这个水平：迅速，并且给人留下深刻的印象。所以，看到他是否能够将这种表现转化为实际成果将会非常有趣。
他在赛车技巧和决策方面的赌注最大，根据他在F2的错误率来看，这些还不够成熟——尽管，讽刺的是，去年贝尔曼作为新秀赛季的赛车手也遇到过类似的情况...
这是对贝尔曼作为未来法拉利F1车手的资历的又一次正式考验。
自从他在沙特阿拉伯作为卡洛斯·塞恩斯因阑尾炎手术而缺席时的替代者出现在赛场上，这似乎就已经注定。
贝尔曼在与尼科·胡肯伯格的比赛中表现出的实力，尤其是在凯文·马格努森被禁赛并且生病的时候，进一步强化了贝尔曼是特殊人才的感觉，他最终将取代刘易斯·汉密尔顿在斯库德利亚车队的位置。
贝尔曼在速度方面至少在原始速度上轻松地击败了奥康。我认为奥康的丰富经验对车队有所帮助，但奥康的整体速度不够快，不够稳定，与贝尔曼相比，无法证明哈斯为他支付的薪酬，以及奥康在车队内部显然具有的尖锐态度。
Camara带来了新的维度——另一位高度评价的F2毕业生，拥有与推动贝尔曼进入F1的法拉利 Academy相似的支持，还有Camara在Portimao的令人印象深刻的Previous Cars测试表现所带来的额外动态。
Camara还没有与贝尔曼进行过真正的正面较量，但在我心中没有疑问，(不考虑商业因素)哈斯现在认为他们账上有了一位他们期望能够给贝尔曼带来真正挑战的车手。
如果炒作不是真的，那么贝尔曼没有什么好担心的，但如果Camara像我们听说的那样出色，那么贝尔曼在2027年将需要找到另一个档位。
他的任务是阻止卡玛拉成为下一个月的新宠，最终试图确保下一个新来的孩子在他之前不会达到法拉利。
这感觉像是哈斯车队目前位置的理想车手阵容氛围——一个已经确立的弱势群体，如果它的车手们最大化他们的机会，并且运气站在他们这边，那么它们可以定期得分。
两位车手试图相互超越，向F1最传奇的车队证明自己，而这个车队也恰好是短期内最有可能出现空缺的顶级车队，鉴于汉密尔顿的职业生涯位置。有太多东西可以争夺，而且没有丝毫的满足感风险。
此外，比尔曼现在相对有足够的经验，可以作为准领导者/基准来依靠。
上一次哈斯车队在车手阵容上全力押注年轻选手，显然是一次糟糕的经历，但与迈克·舒马赫和尼基塔·马泽平驾驶尚未开发的赛车，资金紧张的维持模式年份相比，哈斯车队为2027年准备的贝尔曼和卡马拉则是一个截然不同的前景。
它举办了一场真正的老式射击赛来争夺座位，参赛选手阵容如此多样化，这使得这个故事更加精彩。
卡马拉获得F1的机会是当之无愧的，这种反保守主义的驾驶员选择是竞争对手车队应该注意的。
他到目前为止的青训车队生涯非常引人入胜，从在F4和欧洲区域锦标赛中开始，起初是在基米·安东内利的巨大阴影下。
但是卡马拉并没有慌乱。他选择了慢车道，留在FREC又待了一年，作为一名车手成长并统治了那个赛季，然后在一年后赢得了三级方程式冠军，而安东内利则开始了他的F1首秀。
他来到了F2，并展示了自查尔斯·勒克莱尔以来该类别中最好的原始速度。
他有一些粗糙的边缘。他没有像勒克莱尔那样的毁灭性执行能力。但他拥有所有成功的F2-F1毕业生都有的特质：纯粹的原始速度。
正是这种速度促使哈斯对他进行了赌注，而这种速度也将极大地帮助卡马拉在F1中确立自己。
detailEn: Haas has signed Ferrari junior Rafael Camara to replace Esteban Ocon from the 2027 Formula 1 season.
Is that a good move? What can we expect from Camara, and what does it mean for his 2027 team-mate Ollie Bearman?
A fantastic wildcard addition to F1's 2027 grid
If Rafael Camara is as exciting as I've been told he looked in his Haas F1 test debut, then he is a fantastic wildcard addition to the F1 grid.

His credentials from his junior career make him a worthy graduate anyway. This is a driver who was among the best in karting, and has now pieced together a rare run of consecutive titles higher and higher up the single-seater ladder.

Winning championships is never easy but that alone isn't a guarantee of the kind of ability or traits that will then thrive in F1. The work done in F1 machinery, even in brief opportunities, often counts for far more.

Haas was obviously aware Camara was a promising prospect from his feeder series CV. But, I'm told, it was won over comprehensively when Camara drove its car at Portimao. He was so fast that some in Haas believe that Ollie Bearman - who drove briefly on the day to establish a reference - wouldn't have been as quick even with a proper runplan.
That's not to say Camara is faster or a better prospect than Bearman. But he's that level: rapid, and with an instantly good impression. So it will be fascinating to see if this translates.

Where he's a gamble most is his racecraft and decision-making, which is unpolished based on his Formula 2 error rate - although, ironically, that's something that went for Bearman in his rookie season last year too...
This is the next proper test of Bearman's credentials as a potential future Ferrari F1 driver.
It's almost seemed pre-ordained since he burst onto the scene in Saudi Arabia as the stand-in for Carlos Sainz while Sainz had his appendix removed.

The performances Bearman put up against Nico Hulkenberg, while Kevin Magnussen was suspended and then unwell, only strengthened the feeling Bearman is something special and would eventually replace Lewis Hamilton at the Scuderia.

Bearman has seen off Esteban Ocon fairly comfortably, in terms of raw speed at least. I do think Ocon's greater experience has helped the team, but Ocon isn't overall fast enough, consistently enough, versus Bearman to justify what Haas was paying him, as well as the spiky attitude Ocon apparently had behind the scenes within that team.

Camara brings a new dimension - another highly-rated F2 graduate, with similar Ferrari Academy support that propelled Bearman to F1, and there's the added dynamic of Camara's impressive Testing of Previous Cars performance at Portimao.

Camara hasn't gone properly head-to-head with Bearman yet, but there's no doubt in my mind that (commercial considerations aside) Haas feels it now has a driver on its books that it expects to give Bearman a properly hard time.
If the hype isn't real, then Bearman has nothing to fear, but if Camara is as good as he appears to be from what we've heard so far then Bearman is going to need to find another gear in 2027.
His mission is to stop Camara from becoming the new flavour of the month, ultimately trying to make sure the next new kid on the block doesn't reach Ferrari before he does.

This feels like the ideal driver line-up vibe for a team in Haas's position - a well-established underdog that can score semi-regularly if its drivers maximise their chances and fortune falls its way.

Two drivers trying to climb over each other to prove themselves to F1's most legendary team, which also happens to be the top squad most likely to have a vacancy in the medium-term future given Hamilton's career position. There's everything to fight for and zero risk of complacency.
Plus, Bearman is now relatively experienced enough to lean on as a quasi-leader/benchmark.

Last time Haas went all in on youth for its driver line-up, it was obviously a terrible experience, but a cash-strapped holding pattern year with an undeveloped car driven by Mick Schumacher and Nikita Mazepin was a very different prospect to what Haas has got in store for 2027 with Bearman and Camara.
The fact that it held a proper old-school shootout for the seat with such a varied line-up of candidates makes it an even better story.
Camara getting a shot at F1 is richly deserved, and it's the kind of anti-conservatism driver choice that rival teams should take note of.
He's had a fascinating junior career so far, starting off in the (huge) shadow of Kimi Antonelli in Formula 4 and the Formula Regional European Championship.

But Camara didn't panic. He took the slow path, staying in FREC another year, growing as a driver and dominating that season before adding the Formula 3 crown one year later, while Antonelli made his F1 debut.
He arrived in F2 and demonstrated arguably the best raw pace in the category since Charles Leclerc.
There have been rough edges. He's not had the same devastating execution as the likes of Leclerc. But he shares the trait all successful F2-F1 graduates have had: sheer raw pace.
It's that speed that's prompted Haas to take a gamble on him, and it will be that speed that will go a long way to helping Camara establish himself in F1.

items.originalTitle: Rafael Camara to replace Esteban Ocon at Haas for F1 2027
items.summaryEn: Formula 2 championship leader Rafael Camara will make his Formula 1 debut for Haas in 2027 and is expected to line up alongside Oliver Bearman. The 21-year-old Brazilian is replacing Esteban Ocon, who will leave the American outfit at the end of 2026 after two disappointing seasons, with his departure confirmed on 30 September.
detailZh: 拉斐尔·卡马拉将于2027年接替埃斯特班·奥康加盟哈斯。
这位现任F2积分榜领先者将于明年加入哈斯，完成F1首秀。
F2锦标赛积分榜领先者拉斐尔·卡马拉将于2027年代表哈斯完成F1首秀，预计与奥利弗·贝尔曼搭档。
这位21岁的巴西车手将接替埃斯特班·奥康，后者在经历两个令人失望的赛季后将于2026年底离开这支美国车队，其离队已于9月30日确认。
卡马拉在青训梯队中迅速崛起，赢得了2024年欧洲区域方程式锦标赛冠军和2025年F3总冠军，两场比赛都以压倒性的方式完成。
因此，如果他能为Invicta车队赢得F2总冠军——他目前以七分优势领先尼古拉·佐洛夫——他将成为唯一一位连续几个赛季赢得FRECA、F3和F2冠军的车手。
“我非常高兴能作为一级方程式车手加入TGR哈斯F1车队，”卡马拉说道，他签下了一份“多年”合同。
“这是我职业生涯中重要的一步，我要感谢吉恩·哈斯和小松绫雄对我的信任。
奥利弗·贝尔曼，哈斯F1车队，埃斯特班·奥康，哈斯F1车队
“我也非常感谢法拉利车手学院的支持，以及他们多年来为我发展所做的一切贡献，同时感谢我的家人在这段旅程中一直陪伴着我。
“现在我的重心是为这个新挑战做好最充分的准备。有很多东西要学，我期待与车队紧密合作，了解赛车并作为一名车手继续成长。”
尽管哈斯花了一些时间才确认这一决定，但完全在意料之中，卡马拉将获得这个席位，并战胜现任F2冠军莱昂纳多·福纳罗利和储备车手平川亮等人。
这三人全都参加过哈斯车队的旧车测试项目，其中最引人注目的是8月在波尔蒂芒进行的三天测试，这是评估所有候选车手计划的一部分。
同样有助于卡马拉的因素是他和贝尔曼一样，是法拉利青训车队的毕业生，而法拉利与哈斯关系密切，向其出售了许多赛车部件，比如动力单元。
车队老板小松礼雄表示：“我非常激动能签下像拉斐尔·卡马拉这样年轻而出色的天才。”
“我无需向大家赘述他在初级方程式中的成就，那非常令人印象深刻，而在他参加二级方程式的菜鸟赛季里，他在一些非常困难的时刻展现出的速度，比如在摩纳哥和蒙特利尔的排位赛——这些都表明拉法拥有的潜力。”
“当我们在葡萄牙的TPC项目中让他驾驶时，他展现出即使没有大量时间去学习赛车，他也能很好地应对，他向我们展示的不仅仅是纯粹的速度。
“拉法设法营造了一个能让自己发挥出最佳水平的环境，这非常令人印象深刻，而且他完成的那些圈速确实很特别。
“我们都对这次机会感到兴奋，并且作为TGR哈斯F1车队，我们真心致力于培养这位天才，并为他提供一个能够茁壮成长的地方。
“我们希望营造一个让他感到舒适、得到支持的环境，让他能够真正发挥出自己的能力。”
这条消息意味着2027年理论上只剩下三个席位，其中两个来自小红牛车队，但预计他们会保留利亚姆·劳森和令人印象深刻的新秀阿尔维德·林德布拉德。
另一个是与卡马拉搭档的席位，不过众所周知，这个席位将由21岁的贝尔曼占据，他自去年作为新秀加入以来表现极为出色。
detailEn: Rafael Camara to replace Esteban Ocon at Haas for F1 2027
The current F2 points leader will make his F1 debut by joining Haas next year
Formula 2 championship leader Rafael Camara will make his Formula 1 debut for Haas in 2027 and is expected to line up alongside Oliver Bearman.
The 21-year-old Brazilian is replacing Esteban Ocon who will leave the American outfit at the end of 2026 after two disappointing seasons, his departure being confirmed on 30 September.
Camara has enjoyed a rapid rise through the junior ranks by winning the 2024 Formula Regional European Championship title and 2025 F3 crown, both done in dominant fashion.
So if he clinches the F2 championship for Invicta - he currently leads Nikola Tsolov by seven points - he will become the only driver to have won FRECA, F3 and F2 in consecutive seasons.
“I’m very happy to be joining TGR Haas F1 Team as a Formula 1 driver,” said Camara, who has signed a “multi-year” deal.
“It’s an important step in my career and I want to thank Gene Haas and Ayao Komatsu for the trust they have placed in me.
Oliver Bearman, Haas F1 Team, Esteban Ocon, Haas F1 Team

“I’m also very grateful to the Scuderia Ferrari Driver Academy for their support and for everything they have contributed to my development over the years, as well as to my family for always being there throughout this journey.

“Now my focus is on preparing myself in the best possible way for this new challenge. There will be a lot to learn, and I’m looking forward to working closely with the team, understanding the car and continuing to develop as a driver.”

Although Haas took its time in confirming this decision, it was entirely expected that Camara would be given the seat and triumph over the likes of reigning F2 champion Leonardo Fornaroli and reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa.
All three have taken part in TPC (Testing of Previous Cars) programmes for Haas, the most notable being a three-day test at Portimao in August as part of a plan to evaluate all candidates.

What also would have helped Camara's cause is him being a Ferrari academy graduate - like Bearman - and the Scuderia has a strong relationship with Haas, selling it many car parts like the power unit.
Team boss Ayao Komatsu said: “I’m really excited to sign such a young, amazing talent like Rafael Camara.

“I don’t need to tell everyone about his achievements in the junior formulas, it’s been very impressive, and in his rookie season in Formula 2, the speed he’s shown in some very difficult moments, like qualifying in Monaco and Montreal – that all goes to show the potential Rafa has.
“He showed when we had him drive in our TPC programme in Portugal that he could handle himself very well with not a huge amount of time to learn the car, he showed us more than just raw speed.
“Rafa managed to create an environment to get the best out of himself, it was very impressive and certainly the laps he completed were special.
“We’re all excited about this opportunity and really committed as TGR Haas F1 Team to nurture this talent and provide a place where he can flourish.
“We want to create an environment where he’s comfortable and supported, where he can really excel in his capabilities.”
This news means there are now just three seats theoretically left available for 2027, two coming at Racing Bulls, but it is expected to retain Liam Lawson and impressive rookie Arvid Lindblad.
The other is the seat alongside Camara, though it is an open secret that that’ll be taken up by Bearman, 21, who has highly impressed since joining as a rookie last year.

keyPointsEn: Camara currently leads the Formula 2 standings.

items.originalTitle: Ferrari F1 junior Camara joins Haas: Everything you need to know
detailZh: 法拉利青训车手拉斐尔·卡马拉将签约哈斯车队，2027年首次参加F1比赛。
他在8月的Portimao测试中表现出色，帮助他赢得了哈斯车队车手席位。
他在F2锦标赛中领先，目前领先优势明显。
哈斯车队原本与埃斯特班·奥康的合同将在阿塞拜疆大奖赛周末结束，卡马拉被视为他的接班人。
比赛期间，哈斯车队宣布将在阿塞拜疆大奖赛周末与奥康分手，同时已知卡马拉是接替他的热门人选。
卡马拉在连续两年赢得了欧洲区域方程式锦标赛（Formula 4和Formula 3之间的一个中间阶段）和F3的冠军后，于2026年晋级Formula 2。
这位21岁的巴西车手目前领跑竞争激烈的F2锦标赛，还有两轮比赛（卡塔尔和阿布扎比）尚未进行。
他已经赢得了三场比赛，并且有着2.54的出色排位平均分，但他的比赛并非一帆风顺，哈斯车队负责人小泉昭雄甚至在车队公告中提到了卡马拉棘手的周末——他在摩纳哥犯了一个错误，导致他失去了胜利，在蒙特利尔又犯了一个代价高昂的错误。
“我很高兴能签下像拉斐尔·卡马拉这样年轻、出色的天才，”科马苏斯说。
“我无需向大家讲述他在青训车队的成就，这已经非常令人印象深刻，而且在他的F2菜鸟赛季中，他在一些非常困难的时刻所展现出的速度，比如在摩纳哥和蒙特利尔的排位赛——这些都充分展示了拉斐尔的潜力。”,
当他在葡萄牙的我们的TPC项目中驾驶时，他展现了自己能够很好地掌控自己[并且]在几乎没有时间学习赛车的情况下，他向我们展示的不仅仅是速度。
“拉斐尔成功地创造了一个环境，让自己发挥出最佳水平，这非常令人印象深刻，而且他完成的圈数也特别。”
卡马拉自2021年 karting 时期起就是法拉利的车手学院成员，并将作为有史以来最杰出的青训车队车手晋升到一级方程式。
如果卡马拉连续赢得第三个（主赛季）青训单座赛车冠军，他将成为自奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在2019-21年赢得FREC-F3-F2以来的第一人。
卡马拉表示他很高兴加入哈斯车队，并感谢小松和哈斯一级方程式车队老板吉恩·哈斯对他所给予的信任。
卡马拉说：“我也非常感谢法拉利车队学院的支持，以及他们多年来对我的发展所做出的贡献，还有我的家人，他们一直陪伴着我走过这段旅程。”
“现在我的重点是尽我所能为这个新的挑战做好准备。我将有很多东西要学习，我期待着与团队紧密合作，了解赛车，并继续作为车手不断进步。”
没有官方确认，但预计贝尔曼将被保留，并与Camara一起组成一支全部由法拉利青训车队组成的阵容。
Komatsu反复强调，那些法拉利的联系并没有影响哈斯车队2026年的车手阵容，Camara完全是凭借实力被选中的。
detailEn: Ferrari protege Rafael Camara will make his Formula 1 debut in 2027 after signing a multi-year deal to race for Haas.
The team was blown away by Camara's performance in his Testing of Previous Cars (TPC) outing with the team at Portimao in August, where he set an impressive pace in Haas's 2025 F1 car.
That helped Camara beat the likes of McLaren reserve driver Leonardo Fornaroli, Toyota's Ryo Hirakawa, and ex-Alpine F1 driver Jack Doohan in the race to replace incumbent Esteban Ocon.
Ocon's two years at Haas have fallen short of expectations as he has generally been outpaced by Ferrari junior Ollie Bearman.
The Race revealed Haas would split with Ocon during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend, where it was also known that Camara was the clear favourite to replace him.

Camara won back-to-back titles in the Formula Regional European Championship (an intermediate step between Formula 4 and Formula 3) and F3 in consecutive years before stepping up to Formula 2 in 2026.
The 21-year-old Brazilian currently leads a closely contested F2 championship with two scheduled rounds (Qatar and Abu Dhabi) remaining.

He has won three races and has had a standout qualifying average of 2.54, but it’s been far from a straightforward campaign, with Haas team principal Ayao Komatsu even referencing Camara's tricky weekends - he made a mistake that cost him victory in Monaco and made another costly error in Montreal - in Haas's announcement.
"I'm really excited to sign such a young, amazing talent like Rafael Camara," Komatsu said.

"I don't need to tell everyone about his achievements in the junior formulas, it's been very impressive, and in his rookie season in Formula 2, the speed he's shown in some very difficult moments, like qualifying in Monaco and Montreal - that all goes to show the potential Rafa has.
"He showed when we had him drive in our TPC programme in Portugal that he could handle himself very well [and] with not a huge amount of time to learn the car, he showed us more than just raw speed.
"Rafa managed to create an environment to get the best out of himself, it was very impressive and certainly the laps he completed were special."
Camara has been a member of the Ferrari driver academy since he was in karting in 2021, and will graduate to F1 as its most decorated junior driver ever.
Should Camara win a third consecutive (main season) junior single-seater title, he'll be the first since Oscar Piastri won FREC-F3-F2 in 2019-21.
Camara said he was "very happy" to be joining Haas and thanked Komatsu and Haas F1 team owner Gene Haas for the trust they had placed in him.

"I'm also very grateful to the Scuderia Ferrari driver academy for their support and for everything they have contributed to my development over the years, as well as to my family for always being there throughout this journey," Camara said.

"Now my focus is on preparing myself in the best possible way for this new challenge. There will be a lot to learn, and I'm looking forward to working closely with the team, understanding the car and continuing to develop as a driver."
There is no official confirmation, but Bearman is expected to be retained and form an all-Ferrari-junior line-up alongside Camara.
Komatsu has repeatedly affirmed that those Ferrari links have not influenced Haas's 2026 driver line-up and Camara has been chosen completely on merit.

卡马拉取代了埃斯特班·奥康，其离开哈斯车队在赛季结束后确认，这一消息在九月已经公布。
埃斯特班·奥康表示，除非是在一级方程式赛车中，否则他明年不会驾驶赛车。
"我很高兴能够加入TGR哈斯一级方程式车队，成为一名一级方程式赛车手，"卡马拉说。
“这是我职业生涯的重要一步，我想感谢Gene 哈斯和Ayao Komatsu对我的信任。我也非常感谢Scuderia 法拉利车手学院的支持，以及他们多年来对我的发展的贡献，还有我的家人，他们一直陪伴着我走过这段旅程。”
“现在我的重点是尽我所能为这个新的挑战做好准备。我将有很多东西要学习，我期待着与团队紧密合作，了解赛车，并继续作为车手的发展。”
Camara在8月份在葡萄牙波尔蒂芒赛道测试车队2025年的赛车时给人留下了深刻印象。
车队负责人Ayao Komatsu说：“我非常兴奋能够签约像Rafael Camara这样年轻、出色的天才。”
“我无需向大家讲述他在青训车队中的成就，这已经非常令人印象深刻，在他参加二级方程式赛车（Formula 2）的处子赛季中，他在一些非常困难的时刻展现出的速度，比如在摩纳哥和蒙特利尔的资格赛——这些都充分展示了拉法（Rafa）的潜力。”
“当他在葡萄牙的TGR 哈斯 F1车队项目中驾驶时，他展现了自己在短时间内就能很好地掌握车辆的能力，他向我们展示的不仅仅是速度。”
“拉法成功地创造了一个环境，让自己发挥出最佳水平，这非常令人印象深刻，而且他完成的圈数也特别。”
“我们都对这次机会感到兴奋，并且作为TGR 哈斯 F1车队，我们真正致力于培养这个人才，为他提供一个可以茁壮成长的地方。我们希望创造一个让他感到舒适和支持的环境，让他能够真正发挥自己的能力。”
车队老板Gene 哈斯对Camara能够产生与贝尔曼相似的影响持乐观态度，贝尔曼在车队两个赛季的表现都超过了经验更丰富的奥康。
“在这个级别上是一个不同的挑战，但通过Ollie 贝尔曼的相似轨迹和与Scuderia 法拉利车手学院的关联，我们了解到这些年轻车手准备充分，他们能够立即对车队产生影响，”哈斯说。
“Rafa在TPC的表现给团队留下了深刻印象，所以我们期待在此基础上继续努力，并在下个赛季全面深化我们的关系。”
目前来看，哈斯签下Camara将代表下个赛季车手阵容的唯一变化。小红牛是唯一一支尚未确认2027年两位车手的车队，但劳森和Arvid Lindblad被普遍看好能够留队。

detailEn: Rafael Camara: Haas sign Brazilian Ferrari Academy driver to team for 2027 Formula 1 season on multi-year deal

Rafael Camara has signed a multi-year deal with Haas; the 21-year-old Brazilian is expected to drive alongside Britain's Oliver Bearman next season; Camara is replacing Esteban Ocon;watch every session of the United States GP on October 23-25, live on Sky Sports F1
Formula 2 championship leader Rafael Camara will join Haas on a multi-year deal from the 2027 season as the Brazilian driver steps up to Formula 1.

Camara, 21, has established himself as a rising star over recent years in the junior categories. He won last year's Formula 3 championship and leads this year's Formula 2 standings with two rounds of the season to go.

He is a member of Ferrari's driver academy after joining in 2021, signing at the same time as fellow 21-year-old Oliver Bearman, who joined Haas in 2025 and remains on the Scuderia's books. Haas have not yet confirmed that Bearman will drive for them again in 2027 but are expected to do so soon.

Camara replaces Esteban Ocon, whose departure from Haas at the end of this season after two years was confirmed in September.
Esteban Ocon says he will not drive next year unless it is in Formula One.
"I'm very happy to be joining TGR Haas F1 Team as a Formula 1 driver," said Camara.

"It's an important step in my career and I want to thank Gene Haas and Ayao Komatsu for the trust they have placed in me. I'm also very grateful to the Scuderia Ferrari Driver Academy for their support and for everything they have contributed to my development over the years, as well as to my family for always being there throughout this journey.

"Now my focus is on preparing myself in the best possible way for this new challenge. There will be a lot to learn, and I'm looking forward to working closely with the team, understanding the car and continuing to develop as a driver."
Camara impressed when he tested the team's 2025 car at Portugal's Portimao track in August.
Team principal Ayao Komatsu said: "I'm really excited to sign such a young, amazing talent like Rafael Camara.

"I don't need to tell everyone about his achievements in the junior formulas, it's been very impressive, and in his rookie season in Formula 2, the speed he's shown in some very difficult moments, like qualifying in Monaco and Montreal - that all goes to show the potential Rafa has.
"He showed when we had him drive in our TPC program in Portugal that he could handle himself very well with not a huge amount of time to learn the car, he showed us more than just raw speed.
"Rafa managed to create an environment to get the best out of himself, it was very impressive and certainly the laps he completed were special.

"We're all excited about this opportunity and really committed as TGR Haas F1 Team to nurture this talent and provide a place where he can flourish. We want to create an environment where he's comfortable and supported, where he can really excel in his capabilities."
Team owner Gene Haas is optimistic that Camara is capable of having a similar impact to Bearman, who has outperformed the more-experienced Ocon in both their seasons at the team.

"It's a different challenge at this level but what we've experienced through Ollie Bearman following a similar trajectory and association with the Scuderia Ferrari Driver Academy, these younger drivers are well prepared, and they can make an immediate impact on a team," said Haas.
"Rafa impressed the team with his TPC performance, so we look forward to building on that and growing our relationship full-time next season."

As it stands, Haas' signing of Camara is set to represent the only driver change on next season's grid. Racing Bulls are the one team still to confirm either of their drivers for 2027 but Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad are strong favourites to stay on.

兰多·诺里斯的商业版图现在包括一个在封锁期间诞生的游戏品牌、一个青训赛车队以及一个票务平台的股份。每个项目都投资于一个截然不同的行业。其中一个是部分出售的，一个是他与他人共同创立的赛车队，另一个则是纯粹的 投资。将它们列出来，你可以看到诺里斯在挂上头盔之后，正在寻找构建他未来的途径。
Quadrant：被收购的封锁品牌
诺里斯于2020年创立了Quadrant，当时因为COVID疫情让人们都待在家里，游戏成为了唯一的社交生活。他将其描述为“实际上是一个电子竞技团队，但远不止于此”，从那时起，它已经发展成为一个结合了游戏、内容和甚至时尚品牌的混合体。
也进行了重大的合作，包括索尼、微软、PlayStation和乐高，还包括为在日本大奖赛上赛车而特别定制的Liberty Walk头盔。
在2024年初完成了一笔七位数资金注入后，内容创作者WillNE（Will Lenney）成为了联合所有人。到2024年底，品牌的重点转向了内容开发、服装以及与赛车运动行业的重叠。
公司注册处的文件显示，Quadrant在2024年亏损了902,393英镑。其资产负债表仅从-405,221英镑转为+152,365英镑，这是因为投资者在那一年投入了大约1.46百万英镑的新资金。
同样的文件显示，在Veloce接管之前，Quadrant的股权归属情况。2024年1月，最大的股东是Celero Promotions，诺里斯家族的公司，持有47%的股份。Veloce已经持有23%，而由诺里斯的经理Mark Berryman控制的ADD Motorsports持有8.5%，当时由迈凯伦首席执行官Zak Brown共同拥有的United Autosports持有6%。
较小的投资者包括Carl Eschenbach、Jim Esposito和YouTuber WillNE，他们的股份是以“提供的服务”为交换发行的。
对于一个从游戏频道起步的品牌来说，这是一个相当长的股东名单。
2025年7月，Veloce Media Group收购了Quadrant的多数股权。然而，诺里斯仍然是第二大股东，持股超过20%，并且他也成为了Veloce的股东。当时并未确认购买价格以及他在Veloce的持股规模。
截至2024年6月的十二个月期间，Veloce创造了1280万英镑的收入，利润为35.5万英镑，使其成为一家财务健康但相对规模较小的运营公司。
Quadrant首席执行官Jamie MacLaurin表示：“与Veloce Media Group合作标志着Quadrant一个令人兴奋的新篇章。”Veloce首席执行官Daniel Bailey补充道：“这是一段了不起的成功故事。”
今年9月2日宣布，诺里斯与由Dan Richards领导的投资集团共同创立了LN4 Fusion。从2027年开始，该组织将在意大利F4、欧洲区域F3和F3赛事中参赛。
该机构的总部将位于意大利的威尼托，英国剑桥郡将作为其港口停靠点。
LN4遗产项目通过支持那些没有经济支持在昂贵的赛车运动中进步的有前途的车手来支持这一点。
‘我想为下一代创造机会，无论是在赛道上还是赛道外，’诺里斯说。
诺里斯最新的商业举动发生在几天前，他加入了Seat Unique，这是一个高端接待和活动品牌。这位车手是尼克尔比资本、Pentland Ventures和Hearst Ventures领导的2千万英镑融资轮的一部分。诺里斯通过由职业运动员管理的风险投资工具The Players' Fund进行投资，其贡献金额未公开。
Seat Unique 预计每年销售额将达到1.75亿英镑，并在三年内借助与温布利、阿森纳、电动方程式、Co-op Live以及最近的银石赛道等的关系，实现销售额增长至3.5亿英镑。它还最近收购了P1 Travel，这是一家专注于一级方程式内部接待服务的供应商。
诺里斯在发布这条新闻时表示：“我最好的回忆都来自于现场体育和活动，所以我真的很喜欢Seat Unique正在打造的东西。”
detailEn: Lando Norris's business empire explained: Quadrant, LN4 Fusion and Seat Unique
His ventures span gaming content, junior motorsport and premium sports hospitality
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Lando Norris's business portfolio now includes a gaming brand born in lockdown, a junior racing team and a stake in a ticketing platform. Each venture puts confidence in a very different industry. One has been partly sold, one is a race team he co-founded, and one is purely an investment. Put them in a list and you can see that Norris is looking to build his future after he hangs up the helmet.
Quadrant: The lockdown brand that was bought

Norris founded Quadrant in 2020, while COVID kept everyone indoors and gaming was the only social life going. He described it as “effectively an esports team, but so much more,” and since then it has grown into a mix of gaming, content and even a fashion brand.

Major collaborations have been in place, too, including Sony, Microsoft, PlayStation and Lego, with additional work including a custom Liberty Walk helmet created for racing at the Japanese Grand Prix.

Following a seven-figure funding injection completed in early 2024, content creator WillNE (Will Lenney) became a co-owner. By the end of 2024, the focus of the brand moved to content development, apparel and overlaps with the motorsport industry.
Companies House filings show Quadrant lost £902,393 in 2024. Its balance sheet only swung from −£405,221 to +£152,365 because investors put in around £1.46million of new money that year.

The same filings show who owned Quadrant before Veloce took control. In January 2024 the largest shareholder was Celero Promotions, the Norris family company, with 47%. Veloce already held 23%, while ADD Motorsports, controlled by Norris’s manager Mark Berryman, held 8.5%, and United Autosports, then co-owned by McLaren CEO Zak Brown, held 6%.
Smaller investors included Carl Eschenbach, Jim Esposito and YouTuber WillNE, whose shares were issued in return for “services provided”.
That is a serious list for a brand that started with a gaming channel.

In July 2025, Veloce Media Group bought a majority stake in Quadrant. Norris does, however, remain the second-largest shareholder with over 20% ownership, and he has also become a shareholder in Veloce itself. Neither the purchase price nor the size of his Veloce holding was confirmed at the time.
For the twelve-month period ending June 2024, Veloce created £12.8million in revenue with £355,000 profit, establishing it as a financially healthy but comparatively small operation.

Quadrant CEO Jamie MacLaurin said: “Joining forces with the Veloce Media Group marks an exciting new chapter for Quadrant.” Veloce CEO Daniel Bailey added: “The business has been a fantastic success story.”

Announced on 2 September this year, LN4 Fusion was founded by Norris with an investment group led by Dan Richards. Starting in 2027, the organisation will compete in Italian Formula 4, Formula Regional Europe and Formula 3.
The headquarters of the outfit will be in Veneto, Italy, with a UK port of call in Cambridgeshire.
The LN4 Legacy Programme supports this by backing promising drivers who don't have the financial backing to progress in the expensive world of motorsport themselves.
“I want to help create opportunities for the next generation, both on and off the track,” Norris said.

Norris's latest business move was only a few days ago as he took a position in Seat Unique, a high-end hospitality and events brand. The driver was part of a £20million financing round led by Nickleby Capital alongside Pentland Ventures and Hearst Ventures. Norris invested through The Players' Fund, a venture investment vehicle managed by professional athletes, and his contribution is undisclosed.

Seat Unique is expecting £175million in annual sales and is expecting growth to £350million annual sales within three years with help from its relationships with Wembley, Arsenal, Formula E, Co-op Live and more recently Silverstone. It's also recently acquired P1 Travel, a hospitality vendor that specialises in access within F1.
"Some of my best memories have come from being at live sport and events, so I really like what Seat Unique is building," Norris said on the release of this news.

Norris is planning for his future by investing in various industries.
